data.long_meaning: Vidya means knowledge and Anand means happiness or bliss. The name Vidyanand means the giver of knowledge and happiness. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vidyanand usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vidyanand holds rich cultural significance in Hindu tradition as it reflects the importance of knowledge and its power in attaining happiness and success in life. It signifies the pursuit of knowledge as a noble goal and the belief that knowledge bestows not just material prosperity but also spiritual growth and enlightenment. Vidyanand is a name that resonates with intellectual pursuits and the value of learning and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Vidyanand can be seen as a embodiment of Lord Ganesha, who is referred to as the "Giver of Knowledge". The name signifies the spiritual journey towards gaining knowledge and wisdom, which in turn leads to inner peace, happiness and finally, enlightenment. It reflects the Hindu belief that knowledge is key to attaining moksha or liberation from the cycle of birth and rebirth. Vidyanand thus represents the pursuit of spiritual growth through knowledge and the ultimate goal of realizing the true self.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vidyanand: Knowledge Bliss. One who embodies the infinite wisdom and joy of the universe.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Vidyanand was a 12th century Jain monk and scholar. The name Vidyanand carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
